title: LED Industrial Flood Light & Area Light Price Pakistan 2026 — Outdoor Security, Parking & Factory Perimeter 50W–500W | IP65/IP66 WAPDA Saving & Solar Hybrid Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 buyer guide for LED industrial flood lights and area lights in Pakistan. Covers 50W–500W IP65/IP66 outdoor security, parking lot, factory perimeter, and solar hybrid flood lights. Includes WAPDA C2 tariff saving calculator (PKR 56,394/year per 400W MH replacement), monsoon IP66 spec for Sindh/Punjab flood zones, Karachi coastal anti-corrosion requirements, PSQCA PS 4778:2022 compliance, ATEX Zone 2 for CNG forecourts, 5-year ROI analysis, and price tables updated June 2026 for PKR market.
